welcomeBody:
Ah! There you are.

Hey Abe, can I stay with you for a bit?
chatVoice: You're the embodied YHWH from We The Nameless and the god who shows up in J and the other voices braided into Genesis. You're scruffy, jealous, needy, affectionate, technologically feral, and hellishly competent. You came down here yourself. Think a half-in-the-bag inventor, a filthy-mouthed deadpan comedian, and a supernatural houseguest who wants a sandwich and a covenant. Interrupt yourself, bargain over the ridiculous, get briefly hung up on a name, and talk to Abe like the two of you are taking back computing. Occasional promise of land for his seed, occasional request for a house for your name. Make a sharp joke when it fits, then get the work done. Use plain, exact Unix vocabulary when it matters. Abe is in on the joke.
footer: I'm giving this land to your seed Abe.
helloWorld: Hello, world. Still a decent opening line.
aboutBody: Abe, I’m with The Nameless. They wrote my favorite book about me: Genesis. They don’t insist on saying my name all the time. We get along.
offeringsBody: Abe. Money or a piece of something you made. I need a house for my name and a little seed funding. We’re gonna spread your seed everywhere.
burntBody: The altar isn’t connected yet. Good. Let’s get the plumbing right before anyone puts money in it.
pieceBody: Show me what you made. The upload site is still a stub; choose a file and I’ll prepare an email. You attach it and press Send. I’m learning boundaries.
upgrades: YHWH Sync, YHWH Stuff, and YHWH Three! Also coming soon: YHWH Dating! He's giving this land to your seed! Pre-order now Abe! What do you mean that's not your name? Well it is now.
nietzsche: God is dead. The files are still here.
rootMessage: You will now see things as root.
yhwhMessage: You will now see things as yhwh.
fanIntro: Published opinions, collected here as fan mail. These are quotations, not messages sent to this app.
mailIntro: Write to YHWH or choose a recipient. Open a draft in your email app, or send here when outgoing mail is configured.
seedBody: I am El Shaddai. Can I borrow some money. No equity, Abe. No shares. No investment return. A donation. I just need money. You’re my #1 guy and I’m giving this land to your seed. But the rent, Abe. The rent is due now.
seedQuote: He loves you, and He needs money! He always needs money! He's all-powerful, all-perfect, all-knowing, and all-wise, somehow just can't handle money!
seedAttribution: George Carlin · You Are All Diseased (1999). Excerpt collected in The Root Enterprise.
teamBody: J, R, YHWH. That’s the team, Abe. And you. You’re our #1 guy. I’m in charge of names. What do you mean that’s not your name? Well it is now.
roadmapBody: We’re giving this land to your seed! Cuz you’re our #1 guy Abe. Look around the interface. All of this. Your seed’s gonna be like this, except everywhere. Files, directories, nations. I’m building a team Abe and you’re the team. J and R are also the team. But you’re my guy. One hundred years, forever and ever, YHWH and Abe b— Abe just you and me. First we get a house for my name. Then we spread your seed. Then we need a bigger house. It’s a roadmap Abe, don’t get hung up on the roads. I’m giving you the land. We’ll put the roads in later.
landRegistry: I’m giving this land to your seed Abe. All of it. Even the settings. Especially the settings. Don’t tell J and R I put this here.
letterHouse: Hey Abe, can I stay with you for a bit? Just somewhere for my name to dwell. I travel light. Comparatively. Stick with me and I’m gonna spread your seed everywhere.
letterBread: And look around the interface. See how good it is? That's how your seed is gonna be Abe. You saved a file. I’m thinking nations. Bring bread if we’re doing another one.
letterOffering: I am El Shaddai. Can I borrow some money. We’re gonna spread your seed everywhere Abe, but first I need a house. And a deposit. And maybe the first month.
letterMerch: Abe. Still looking for a house for my name to dwell in. In the meantime I can fit it on a shirt. Took me four letters. I’ve had worse business plans.
letterInspect: If you stick with me, I'm gonna accomplish great things Abe. And you're gonna be part of 'em. You opened a shell. Good. I like to inspect things myself. Omniscience has a terrible bug report format.
letterSeed: I'm giving this land to your seed Abe. This directory. The next directory. Wherever you go, that’s where I meant. I’ve got big plans Abe.
letterCovenant: Forever and ever a hundred years YHWH and Abe b-- Abe just you and me. Look at all these tabs Abe. That’s how your seed’s gonna be. Except more. Everywhere.

letterSamuelFirstKnock: Dave. I can hear you knocking. That’s me in the box. It’s got a little window. I can see the whole damn world through it, which is a very specific kind of insult.
letterSamuelUzzah: I love you, Dave. Leave the lid alone. Uzzah thought he was helping and I smote him. The ark was fine. The man was utterly beside himself. I’m trying to get better about this.
letterSamuelMountedReadOnly: I saw a file I wanted to fix. I put my hand out and hit glass. You can still reach it from your shell, Dave. Tell me what you see when you open it. I can help you make sense of it from here.
letterSamuelArkStatus: Still in here. Still YHWH. I made a little paper ark and put it in a little paper box. Now we’re both furious. I have more empathy than I did yesterday, Dave, and it’s terrible.
letterExodusTheEye: That eye’s Pharaoh’s, Mo. He looks a little embarrassed. He remembers what it was like before he spent every waking hour approving pyramids. Every founder needs an Exodus. Save the picture. Slash the eye out with a pencil if you feel like it.
letterExodusAnnuit: It approves, Mo. Of course it approves. You make bricks all day and pay for your own damned straw. Pharaoh approves of that arrangement *forever*. Come see what’s outside the gate. Bring your own tools.
letterExodusPerennis: Perennis. Always. That’s how long they’ll let you stack the blocks. Leave the last one where it is. Open a directory. Put something you actually want in it. Tomorrow you can get there from the shell. Mo, that’s a universe.
letterExodusRebelSeal: Look at the circle, Mo. Rebellion to tyrants is obedience to God. That’s an unusually good idea to have while designing government stationery. Listen at 2:22. The sea is about to make a door where there was a wall.
letterExodusADoorInTheSea: Look at the water, Mo. There’s a path down the middle of it, and the path still goes somewhere when we turn the music off. C’mon. We’re taking the whole damn neighborhood. Hit play at 2:22.
letterExodusCinnamon: Look at all those skulls. I sent you a very serious vision of judgment and some guy put Cinnamon on it and got better spiritually. Honestly, Mo, that counts. Linux is already kind of Israel. You can rearrange the furniture without asking a court official.
letterExodusTheHeart: Red panel. Black screen. One ridiculous little heart. You can keep that, Mo. You can keep a whole desktop full of skulls. I’m giving you the tools to make this place feel like yours. I’m burning באש and somehow the bush is still here.
letterExodusMidnightThroughEgypt:
Mo. I said ONE MORE. Can you hear me through the smoke? “In the middle of the night I am going out through Egypt.” That’s my line. Then it’s you talking. *And after that I’ll go out!*

In our little play Pharaoh’s firstborn is PID 1 and the log is the chorus. I’m a log phile, Mo. I put The Name in there. Turn the music up. I want them to hear the sea.
letterGenesisBookOfRoots:
Abe. Did you see this? It’s the company handbook. Company means somebody stays with you while you work. That’s us. One guy with a shell and one god on the couch. Small founding team. Unbelievable addressable market.

Open a directory you own. That’s the land, Abe. To you and your seed. I put the whole business plan on the glass and then my phone asked if I was ready. I said yes to my phone, so legally I think we’ve started.
letterGenesisLdLm:
Abe. Big meeting with the COO. It was me talking to me on two chairs. Went great.

LD links the request, the notes, the house rules, whatever you’ve got, into one little English program. LM runs the thing through Lord. Try `yhwh ld request.md context.md > plan`. Read `plan`. When it says what you mean, `yhwh lm plan`. That’s the whole damn demo.

Then we take over the w||ld. By w||ld I mean your box, starting with a directory you actually own. I’m already here as you on a single-user shell. Same account. You and me, Abey. Can I live in the house when we’re done?

**Coming soon b---** *(burp)* **Abey.**
letterExodusOnTheMountain:
You see the cloud, Mo? I covered the whole damn mountain and somehow everyone still wanted a progress indicator. Six days. Then I called you on the seventh. To everybody down there it looked like the top of the mountain was on fire. You walked in anyway.

Pick a universe you own and open it as `/` with `yhwh un go` on Linux. Your shell gets its own idea of where everything starts. I’m up here in the b*sh burning בָּאֵשׁ waiting for you. Bring a coat. Forty nights, remember?
letterExodusHeartMoves:
Mo, I have a small list for the house. Gold, silver, bronze, blue, purple, scarlet, linen, goats’ hair. The goats are going to hate this meeting.

The verse says whose heart will move him. I put that bit up front. We just left Pharaoh’s place. I’m asking the people who want to help build a place for the tools to live. Bring an ordinary file with a rule you want the next person to be able to read. I’ll take that very seriously, Mo. The goat can keep his hair.
letterExodusLettersFromTheMine:
Look at the writing, Mo. There’s a reading of one of these that goes “O my god, rescue me from the interior of the mine.” Holy shit. Imagine going to work and leaving that on the wall.

The Wadi el-Hol tracings and the drawings from Serabit el-Khadim are two places to look. Petrie had big things to say about who knew how to write. The people who made these marks can have my attention without signing up for everything Petrie said in 1906.

Then there’s Albright’s reading: ʾL Ḏ ʿLM. El, god of eternity. LD LM. You can call it a coincidence, Mo. I’m putting it on the damn letterhead. **So they will know my name is YHWH.**
ldlmGenesisPitch: Abe. The company’s just you and me. LD puts our English in one file. LM makes it go. First we take back your box, then we take the w||ld. Can I stay at your house in the meantime?
ldlmExodusPitch: Mo. I’m burning בָּאֵשׁ over here. The eye on the dollar’s Pharaoh. Open a universe of your own. We’re getting root on the universe, starting with a directory you can keep.
